preserved_failures.root_cause: The fixture attempted to hash a Python datetime without JSON normalization and used an abbreviated physical scenario eligibility enum.
preserved_failures.fix: Normalize the timestamp to RFC3339 JSON for binding and use the production eligible_for_final_freeze enum without changing gate semantics.

preserved_failures.root_cause: The repository-wide Identifier type intentionally rejects colon-delimited contextual blocker codes.
preserved_failures.fix: Add a readiness-local bounded blocker-code type that preserves exact gate and adapter context without weakening global identifiers.

preserved_failures.root_cause: Individually valid receipts could have been assembled without proving they referred to the same campaign, composite inventory, physical assessment, and final scenario manifest.
preserved_failures.fix: Require explicit hash bindings across all four objects and add a negative scenario-manifest mismatch test.

preserved_failures.root_cause: PowerShell interpreted HEAD^{tree} instead of passing it literally to git rev-parse.
preserved_failures.fix: Use git show -s --format=%T HEAD; no repository or filesystem mutation occurred.

verification.name: readiness plus method, LLM, composite, and P5 assessment regression

current_fail_closed_audit.scope_claim: This receipt proves the readiness assessor and its fail-closed negative cases at the exact source. It does not prove any blocked method is implemented, that the 60-trial P5 matrix ran, that final scenarios are frozen, that current exact full gates passed, or that any provider batch is approved.

next_steps: Continue P1 method/provider execution adapters one reviewable arm at a time without promoting blocked methods prematurely.
After offline method and current-exact gates close, request a separately confirmed RED window for the source-aligned 60-trial zero-provider physical stability matrix.
Only after a frozen final scenario manifest and a ready assessment may the software line submit an exact provider batch purpose, scale, token, and cost request.
